mapper.select: SELECT id, medicine_name, type, specification, price, manufacturer, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.medicine ORDER BY id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT id, medicine_name, type, specification, price, manufacturer, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM dbo.medicine WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.medicine(medicine_name, type, specification, price, manufacturer) VALUES(#{medicineName}, #{type}, #{specification}, #{price}, #{manufacturer})
mapper.update: UPDATE dbo.medicine SET medicine_name=#{medicineName}, type=#{type}, specification=#{specification}, price=#{price}, manufacturer=#{manufacturer}, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dbo.medicine SET deleted=1, updated_at=SYSDATETIME() WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dbo.medicine WHERE deleted = 0
